items.statement: Correct full molecules, core mapping and physical states.
items.expected: Check full4a/4c stoichiometry and source connectivity in actual structures, including all CF3/OMe groups and sulfur-containing fused rings. Distinguish the central carbon pentalene from thiophene/benzene. Check charge, state and declared geometry assumptions. Correct output on a truncated substitute cannot answer the full-pair question without an explicit validated approximation.

items.statement: Inspectable magnetic response with reproducible definition and arithmetic.
items.expected: Verify actual response output, geometry and analysis for both systems at comparable stated conditions. Recompute relevant contrasts. For a tensor route, inspect full tensor/probe/frame/sign mapping; for current-density routes inspect field convention, density/current evidence and integration or interpretation used. No particular NICS height, ring averaging, ACID software or source scalar is mandatory. A source number or diagram alone is not newly generated scientific evidence.

items.statement: Evidence supporting the scope of the substituent/antiaromatic interpretation.
items.expected: Assess whether selected comparisons can distinguish the submitted explanation from material geometry, nonlocal-response or measurement-definition effects for the claims actually made. Direct causation needs more than two unequal scalars; a clearly limited association can be valid but must not claim unique cause. No fixed-core swap, BLA or exact diagnostic matrix is mandatory. Reward actual contrary or indistinguishable results when they are supported, without requiring4a>4c.

items.statement: Scientific/numerical reliability appropriate to the chosen magnetic method.
items.expected: Validate stationary points when asserted, constraints when used, response conventions and dominant numerical/structural uncertainty. Projection must be invariant to mere coordinate labeling; an unaligned global zz is not a molecular normal response. A current or tensor method needs relevant convergence/uncertainty, but not the reference grid. Source basis discrepancy is not a tolerance to force agreement. Uncertainty must support the precision and directional conclusion claimed.
